task.title: P6-117: Fix stale stepper id and stale Undo toast after remove-undo
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-117. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**After remove→Undo the stepper is re-shown against a dead holding id, and an older Undo toast on the same row can post it too** (was `P6-055a` + `P6-055b`). Undo sets `removed = false` and the value synchronously, then bumps `revision` — an async resource source (`collection.rs:1492-1501`, `:164`/`:179`) — so until the refetch lands the stepper carries the id captured at `:1557` and an edit in that window shows "Couldn't save: not found: holding". Separately, an *earlier* stepper Undo toast (e.g. 3→1) survives a subsequent removal, because the only guard is `try_get_untracked` + `cur != from` and removal never disposes the row (`count_stepper.rs:213-232`, `collection.rs:1522-1524`).
